entries.mitigation: Leave the large fire ground effect immediately during the mage phase.
Step out of the repeated ground slams until the sequence finishes, then return to position.
Block or sidestep the conal tail attack to avoid the knockdown.
Move or dodge roll out of the erupting ground marker, then restack once Tremorscale emerges.
Watch your feet and move out of the incoming lightning impact circles from the blue construct.
Keep the yellow construct faced away from the group and block or dodge its heavy frontal attack.
If the red construct targets you, kite its spinning chase away from the group until it stops.
Stay out of the large lightning ground effect while continuing damage from safe space.
Move out of or block the close-range whirlwind attack.
Move out of the crushing-hand AoE; if caught, block and break free promptly.
Move out of the scattered lightning pools before overlapping damage builds.
Leave the large AoE immediately and do not let the moving wind push you back into it.
Stay at moderate range so Neidir does not punish distant players with a long charge.
Track the moving wind and recover quickly from knockdown before another dangerous AoE overlaps.
Stay out of the poison cone; the tank can hold position and block if necessary.
Sidestep the long charge lane and reposition once Atarus stops.
Keep non-tanks behind the boss and out of the large frontal fire cone.
Hold position while landing spots are chosen, then move when the fireballs begin to fall so the room is not carpeted in AoEs.
Pull ranged skeletons into the boss and clear them with AoE before they accumulate.
Non-tanks step out of the small spin AoE and return after it finishes.
The transformed player stays with the group and uses skeleton attacks until the transformation expires; the group compensates for the temporarily missing role.
